description: This file defines an enumeration `LoanScheduleType` to specify different types of loan schedules, specifically 'Cumulative' and 'Progressive'. It includes methods for converting enum values to a list of `EnumOptionData` objects, converting an enum value to `EnumOptionData`, and creating a `LoanScheduleType` from an `EnumOptionData`. It is part of the loan account scheduling domain in the Fineract project.
